# streamtime_kafka_connection_configuration (Data Source)

Reads what a client needs to connect to a Confluent Platform cluster on your own virtual machines (workload cpansible): client properties, the CA certificate and the Control Center login. Other Kafka providers are not supported. The values include credentials and are stored in the Terraform state; protect the state accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Confluent Platform on your own virtual machines (workload cpansible) only.
data "streamtime_kafka_connection_configuration" "vm" {
  kafka = "vm-cluster"
}

output "client_properties" {
  value     = data.streamtime_kafka_connection_configuration.vm.client_properties
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kafka` (String) Identifier of the Kafka cluster.

### Read-Only

- `ca_certificate` (String) PEM CA certificate the client trusts.
- `ca_filename` (String) File name client_properties expects the CA certificate at.
- `client_properties` (String, Sensitive) Kafka client properties (bootstrap servers, security settings and credentials), in .properties format.
- `control_center_password` (String, Sensitive) Control Center password, if Control Center is installed.
- `control_center_username` (String) Control Center user name, if Control Center is installed.
